$format.about: The house wording the renderer prints and the AI is told. Read by src/bms/playbook.py, which rejects a malformed file. Values marked in $draft are Phase 0 placeholders in the house form; workstream 1 confirms or replaces them from the Master Template and the house style and empties $draft.
$format.verbs: Exactly the five house verbs of the Job model, in this order.
$format.owner_brackets: Per furnishing party other than AME: the bracket printed after the device ({owner} in a shape's wording). Every party of the Job model except AME has one.
$format.integration_trio: lines: the three lines, in order ({what} names the equipment, or is left out for plain factory controls); depths: the depth of each line (1 or 2).
$format.clarifications: Per clarification kind (confirm, assumed, per_drawings, note): the form of the block's one "*" line. Placeholders: {text} the clarification's text. Every form starts with "*".
$format.header: count: the {n} form of a known count; unknown_count: what {n} prints when the count is unknown; tags_joiner: between tags.
$format.count_causes: The quantity note's words for why the plan placements are above the other counts, when the equipment counts line names it (bms.render). form: printed after the "plan placements" clause ({causes}: the causes, joined by joiner); typical: a typical unit placed at each place; labelled_twice: one unit labelled more than once on a sheet. Client words only: never a tag, a sheet or an estimator's hint ("check ...").
$format.quantity: line: the {qty} form on a line whose quantity differs from the block's ({n} the count); unknown: the {qty} form when it is unknown; others_note: the block's one quantity note, printed after its clarification ({counts}: each count with other counts in the documents as "(N) per <label>; M per <label>", the printed (highest) count first and the others highest first, at most five clauses; a label is the sheet number the source names (M-100.00), else what its quote counted ("plan placements", "schedule rows", "the schedule", "the riser", "the sheet pictures"), else a schedule or section name; a count with no label is left out, never "per the documents"; values from one label folded as "1 and 0 per <label>", the counts joined by "; "). Device names print in Title Case with the house acronyms kept (BMS, VFD, DDC, CO, NO, ERV, RTU, IT, HPAC, SCR, UUKL, FA, BACnet); a device named by a house line with no verb (Map Available Points..., the mfr. rep line) prints that line as written, with no verb; a header for one unit (one tag or a count of 1) reads its kind word singular. Clarification texts: a label the text already carries ("*", "Confirm", "Assumed:", "Quantity per") is not printed twice, and a per_drawings text prints as its trade word ("*Quantity per plumbing drawings").
$format.confirmed: Workstream 1, 2026-10-04. Verbs: the GEM's five ownership verbs (the Master Template's bare 'Install' has no Job model verb; it is not used). Owner brackets: GEM 'Other trades in brackets' and the practice rules for Unit Mfr., FA, Others and Mechanical Contractor; Electrical Contractor and Owner follow the same form (GEM names both parties). Integration trio: the Master Template and house style, word for word. Clarifications: the old app's printed forms ('*Confirm quantity: ...', '*Assumed: ...'), the practice rule's '*Quantity per plumbing drawings', and the house style's '**' client note. Quantity: the GEM's '(Qty. N Total)' and the estimator's 'Qty (##)' for unknown.
